why: Step 1 passes, steps 2 and 3 fail. (1) The quoted sentence EXISTS VERBATIM at whats-new/2026-w29.md line 60 (raw markdown escapes the underscores exactly as quoted); it is a one-sentence <div> in the 'Other wins' grid with no reversing second half. The linked page corporate-launcher.md confirms the mechanism. (2) The cited evidence is wrong on both halves. packages/server-core/src/pi-harness/process-supervisor.ts is NOT 'the Pi subprocess supervisor' - it is the supervisor for the shell/tool processes the agent runs on the user's behalf (ProcessSupervisorPort, matchExcludedCommand, resolveProcessIsolation). And its spawn is NOT unwrapped: line 244 reads `child = (this.options.spawnProcess ?? spawn)(plan?.command ?? request.command, plan?.args ?? args, { ... env: plan?.environment ?? processEnvironment ... })`, where `plan` comes from resolveProcessIsolation and rewrites the command into a sandbox invocation - the comment at :232 says so in as many words ('The REQUESTED command line, before isolation rewrote it into a sandbox invocation'). That spawn site already has wrapper indirection, just a sandbox one rather than a corporate launcher. This is the sibling-subsystem refutation shape: the file named is Claude's CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX territory, not CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER's - corporate-launcher.md:137 draws exactly that line ('CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER wraps Claude Code's own processes ... CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX wraps the shell commands Claude runs on your behalf, such as Bash tool calls, hooks, and the commands that start stdio MCP servers'). By that same sentence the claim's second example, 'the session MCP server', is also misfiled under this page. (3) The third example is false outright: background agent sessions in this fork spawn no executable at all. packages/server-core/src/pi-harness/child-session-service.ts drives children through an in-process ChildRuntime interface (start/resume/steer/stop/monitor) with zero child_process usage in the file. The consequence therefore does not follow from the identifier. Structurally, the process classes corporate-launcher.md:23-31 enumerates - the background service `claude agents` starts on demand, the terminal host and session in every agent view row plus warm standby, respawns after update or crash, the self-relaunch that finishes an update, Remote Control workers, agent-teams tmux/iTerm2 teammate panes - have no analog here. This is an Electron app whose update relaunch is autoUpdater.quitAndInstall (apps/electron/src/main/auto-update.ts:420), performed by Squirrel/electron-updater rather than by a spawn we control, which is the same category the page itself excludes for launchd/systemd-started services. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-claude-coverage-map.md row 129 already records corporate-launcher as a dated verdict, marked out of product. The identifier absence itself is real - grep -a over packages/ and apps/ for PROCESS_WRAPPER, processWrapper, SHELL_PREFIX, launcherPath, wrapperExecutable and processLauncher returns zero source hits - but the finding as written names the wrong subsystem, asserts an unwrapped spawn at a site that is wrapped, and attributes a consequence to two surfaces that either belong to a different Claude mechanism or spawn nothing.
correctedState: No reader exists for CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER or a processWrapper setting (grep -a, zero source hits in packages/ and apps/), and no NESSY_-prefixed equivalent exists. But the surface this page covers - processes the product starts from its own binary: a background service, agent-view row sessions and warm standbys, respawns after update or crash, the self-relaunch that installs an update, Remote Control workers, tmux teammate panes - does not exist in this fork. Background children are in-process (packages/server-core/src/pi-harness/child-session-service.ts, ChildRuntime), and the update relaunch is electron-updater's autoUpdater.quitAndInstall (apps/electron/src/main/auto-update.ts:420), i.e. performed by Squirrel/NSIS rather than by a spawn we control - the same category corporate-launcher.md excludes for launchd/systemd. The cited file is the wrong subsystem twice over: packages/server-core/src/pi-harness/process-supervisor.ts supervises the agent's shell/tool processes, which corporate-launcher.md:137 assigns to CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX and not to this variable, and its spawn at :244 is already wrapped by the sandbox isolation plan (plan?.command ?? request.command). The only unwrapped spawn genuinely in this page's spirit is the Pi subprocess at packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:1461 (this.spawnProcess(nodePath, args, ...) with nodePath = runtime.paths?.node || process.execPath), plus the bundled session-mcp-server launcher and the stdio MCP spawn at packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/plugin-runtime-dependencies.ts:238 - and the last two are SHELL_PREFIX's domain, not this page's. corporate-launcher is already recorded as out of product at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-claude-coverage-map.md row 129.
